agentPolicyIds.description: Agent policy IDs for agent_based existing-policy deploys. Provided on create so that a mid-deploy tab-close leaves a record that hydrates back into existing mode.

authMethod.description:
Authentication method. Allowed values depend on the delivery mechanism:

- managed_integration: identity_federation | static_keys
- agent_based: static_keys (direct_access_keys) | temporary_keys | shared_credentials | assume_role

connectorId.description: ID of the fleet-cloud-connector to associate with this deployment. Omit for static-keys deployments.

globalRegion.description: Global AWS region from the Service Settings step.

mechanisms.description: Delivery mechanisms active in this deployment.

services.description: Service IDs to be covered by this deployment.

serviceVars.description: Per-service config keyed by instance ID.
